findings.current: Haz clic en “Crear programación” para pedirle a un agente …
findings.proposed: Haz clic en “Nueva tarea programada” para pedirle a un agente …
findings.reason: The tour targets button[data-tour-tag=create-schedule-button], whose es label in schedules-page.tsx is ui.schedules.schedules_page.new_scheduled_task = “Nueva tarea programada”; “Crear programación” is only the dialog's submit label, and the context requires the quote to match the control the user clicks (the English source “Create schedule” is itself stale against “New scheduled task” — flag to the source owner).

findings.current: rutas de archivo de tu equipo / Todos los archivos que creen tus agentes en tu equipo
findings.proposed: rutas de archivo de tu dispositivo / … creen tus agentes en tu dispositivo
findings.reason: English says “your device” in these two keys and glossary §2 fixes device→dispositivo, while the same glossary/es guide reserve “equipo” for team; welcome.body.1 uses “un equipo de agentes” two sentences before welcome.body.2 uses “en tu equipo” for the computer. (“equipo” for “computer” in the other four keys and in ~90 sibling strings is settled usage; only the two literal “device” keys drift.)

findings.current: usando sus memorias y el contexto
findings.proposed: usando lo que recuerda y el contexto
findings.reason: “sus memorias” is a calque of “its memories”; Spanish “memorias” reads as written memoirs/reports, and no sibling catalogue uses it for agent memory (agent_capabilities.body.1 correctly says “tienen memoria”).
Sentence case per the es guide and sibling ui.settings.shortcuts strings (“abre la paleta de comandos…”); only the heading/title key is capitalised.

findings.current: Algunas solicitudes potentes que puedes probar:
findings.proposed: Algunas peticiones eficaces que puedes probar:
findings.reason: “solicitudes potentes” is a word-for-word render of “powerful requests”; “eficaces”/“útiles” reads more native. Same calque pattern in schedules_overview.body.1 (“muy potente”) is acceptable.

findings.current: cuadro de redacción / campo de chat

findings.reason: The same on-screen object is named with two different nouns in one namespace; meaning is clear either way.
